description:
Programme or Project Overview

Utrecht University is hiring a postdoc on the responsible scaling of digital innovation in mental healthcare. The project studies how digital tools in mental health services, from e-mental-health platforms to data-driven support systems, can be scaled beyond pilot settings in ways that remain safe, equitable and clinically sound.

The postdoc will study scaling processes empirically, analyse policy and governance conditions, and develop frameworks that help innovators, providers and funders scale responsibly. The research sits at the intersection of science and technology studies, implementation science and mental health services research. The appointment is a salaried postdoctoral contract under the CAO-NU collective agreement.

Candidate profile

Applicants hold a PhD in social sciences, health sciences, innovation studies or a related field, with an interest in digital health and qualitative-quantitative mixed methods. Experience with interview studies, document analysis or evaluation research is an advantage. The working language is English, and the postdoc collaborates with mental-health service partners.

Highlights

  • Responsible scaling of digital mental-health tools
  • Implementation and evaluation research
  • Governance and policy analysis
  • Mixed-methods empirical studies
  • Collaboration with mental-health service providers
  • Salaried postdoc under the CAO-NU agreement

About Utrecht University

Utrecht University is a leading Dutch research university, consistently ranked among the top institutions in Europe. Its research and teaching span four faculties and a broad range of strategic themes, including sustainability, dynamics of youth, institutions for open societies and life sciences. PhD candidates and postdocs in the Netherlands are salaried staff members with full employment benefits under the CAO-NU collective agreement, so advertised positions are fully funded. Academic and support vacancies are published on the university's working-at portal, with clear deadlines and application instructions per position.
